summary: release_publication: BLOCKED. tests.name: T10 Annotated git tag creation and push
tests.evidence: Not run because formal npm publication was BLOCKED; the remote v0.3.0 tag remained absent and was not created or modified.

tests.evidence: Not run because formal npm publication was BLOCKED; the v0.3.0 GitHub Release remained absent.

tests.name: T12 Post-publication registry install smoke

tests.name: T13 Safety and cleanup boundary
